the state three primary initialiser returns a word whose EAX comes from an unresolved callee rather than from the object it just initialised, and the native stores that word as the handle. The model stores the port return verbatim and records the port return type as a word, so the shape is faithful but the provenance is an open port question
the two builder states add eight to the returned pointer, so the model uses a byte offset rather than pointer arithmetic; getting this wrong silently shifts every handle field by one structure

the vtable addresses stored by the six vtable assigned states are absolute addresses in the binary image, so the model routes the three virtual calls through a resolver port instead of dereferencing them; the clusters at 0x013f1af4 through 0x013f1b40 are unattributed in docs/analysis/vtables.json
eight dead branches are folded by XOR with zero and never taken, several of which would dereference address zero; the model omits them and the model test pins the reachable consequences instead
the dead read of an uninitialised stack word just before each fresh handle step has no observable effect and is omitted

the reference add and release are LOCK XADD and indirect virtual calls in the native; the model performs the add and release through the resolved vtable port, and the reference count itself is a plain increment rather than an atomic

the state machine is entered with the state field, and the jump table entries skip each block's own state store, so the store is idempotent on a re entry; the model keeps the store on every visit, which is unobservable
